item.title: Combiner 0.10.5
item.description:
• A take or sample that only changes later on (a new second drop, say) is now shared as a new version, instead of being held back as a copy of someone else's file.
  • Joined a new room? The song open in your DAW now counts there, and Render All shares and renders it.
  • Render All says what to do when it can't find your song, and every failure is in the log.
